observations.finding: 27 of 50 pathways significant at q<0.05; strongest effects: HEMME_METABOLISM down (SMD -1.00, q=0.0001), PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS down (SMD -0.81, q=0.0014), ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION up (SMD +0.80, q=0.0011), IL6_JAK_STAT3 up (SMD +0.72, q=0.0013), INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE up (SMD +0.61, q=0.0077).

No gene significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.075). PBRM1 depleted (freq 0.258 vs 0.561, OR 0.27, 95% CI 0.12-0.63, p=0.0034, q=0.075); BAP1 enriched (0.177 vs 0.049, OR 4.21, q=0.43); VHL similar (0.50 vs 0.61, q=0.87).

17 of 49 continuous features significant at q<0.05; VHL, SETD2, PBRM1, BAP1 loci and chr20q higher in set (Cliff's delta ~0.50-0.54, q<0.001). Gain/loss: chr14q loss enriched (0.532 vs 0.220, OR 4.05, q=0.019), chr6p loss and PTEN loss enriched (0.177 vs 0, OR 18.5, q=0.024).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Strong, coherent RNA and CNV signals with multiple significant pathways and loci; WXS shows a directionally consistent PBRM1 depletion and BAP1 enrichment but does not reach q<0.05. The RNA and CNV findings are mutually reinforcing within this set.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0001 shows a distinct molecular profile with downregulated heme metabolism and upregulated inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 signaling, plus copy-number differences at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/BAP1 loci and chr14q/chr6p/PTEN losses. These are descriptive associations only; no prognostic or clinical inference is made.
limitations: WXS findings are not significant after multiple-testing correction.
Pathway and CNV results are relative to the rest of the partition and do not establish subtype identity.

actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, mutually reinforcing RNA and CNV identity evidence (heme metabolism down, inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 up, reciprocal CNV at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/BAP1 loci), no significant technical confounder association, and cross-modal membership support with positive silhouettes across modalities. Structure is compatible at the current granularity, though boundary separation from C0002 is modest and driven mainly by RNA, so residual uncertainty remains for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent molecular profile reciprocal to C0001 (heme metabolism up, inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 down, reciprocal CNV at the same loci), no significant technical confounder association, and cross-modal membership support with positive silhouettes. Structure is compatible at the current granularity, with residual uncertainty from modest boundary separation from C0001.
